content: Plan: Stage-3 REQ-1 @bv tag, parse-gated (thermite-syntax only). Mechanism = cargo feature 'bv_shadow' (non-default) = compiled-in shadow-flag plumbing; the parser path accepting the tag is #[cfg(feature)]-gated, so a build without it structurally cannot parse the tag (G3 lock, R-BV-1). Files: lexer.rs (lex '@' -> TokKind::At + token_text), ast.rs (BvWidth + BvTag + Clause.bv: Option<BvTag>), parser.rs (parse_bv_tag in parse_clause; off=>SyntaxError::BvTagWithoutShadowPlumbing, bad width=>BvWidthInvalid), cross-crate Clause{} literals get bv:None, new test bv_tag_parse.rs (cfg(not)=parse-error, cfg=4 widths+nowrap round-trip), CI --features bv_shadow run. AC-1.
